sources.title: Introducing vision to the fine-tuning API - OpenAI
sources.snippet: All fine-tuned models will remain available for inference until their base models are deprecated ⁠. The full timeline is here ⁠. Today, we're introducing vision fine-tuning ⁠ on GPT‑4o 1, making it possible to fine-tune with images, in addition to text.
